title: The Five Foundational Sayings That Establish the Mind of Light
description: Five foundational sayings — names of the great divine persons and the law of their operation — taught as the doctrinal ground upon which the Mind of Light is established in the soul. The unnameable Father; the Ambassador / Father of Life; the living law of those who are good and bitter; the Mother giving the king of light unto Enmity; and the unity of all in one living body until the last time. Five seals fix the regenerate mind against the mingled state.
